reviews.text:
We had such a great experience at Jackson’s Place! Leaving your dog somewhere new can be nerve-wracking, but they made us feel completely at ease. They sent regular updates with photos, videos, and report cards, so we always knew how Benji was doing throughout his stay.

It was so fun seeing him make new friends and have such a great time playing. When we picked him up, he was happy, well cared for, and clearly had an amazing experience. The staff genuinely seem to love the dogs they care for, and it really shows. We’ll definitely be bringing Benji back. Highly recommend Jackson’s Place to anyone looking for a caring and trustworthy place for their pup!

I started bringing my puppy to Jackson's place back in October because I was looking for a place to board my dog when I had to leave for a work trip, and my trainer recommended them (first green flag). As a puppy, he was shy and timid (first photo). Yet over the course of the past four months, taking him once a week, and having boarded him for a few days, it is almost like I have a new dog (see the other three photos). He's so much more confident, and excited to play with other dogs (second green flag). That's a testament to how much fun he has with his furry friends. But it is also a profound reflection of the staff, and the deep amount of care that they put into watching over the dogs at the facility. Plus, the regularly send videos and photos of your dog with a report card at the end of the day (photos posted are courtesy of them, and are pretty great quality). For this, I would say you're getting more than your money's worth.

To say the least, Jackson's Place will always have a special place in our hearts, and so glad I was able to find them here in Houston.

My dog just wrapped up her first day of daycare at Jackson’s Place and had a blast! The staff was super friendly and you can tell they really care about the dogs. I was able to check in on her via live cameras all day, which was comforting and fun to see. They also sent more than 20 photos of her after the visit and a couple of super cute videos. She even got to swim! Everything was very clean and professional.

Willie is fantastic! Friendly, patient, and clearly great with dogs. My dog Skye can be pretty nervous, but she does so well with him and seems completely at ease. She always comes back looking amazing and, more importantly, happy. The front desk staff is also always so pleasant and helpful, which makes the whole experience even better. Highly recommend Willie for grooming!

I’ve been taking my dog to Jackson’s Place for a few weeks now, and it’s honestly been such a positive experience. What really stands out to me is how excited he gets when we arrive. Seeing him so happy to go in gives me a lot of peace of mind!

We live nearby in Midtown, so being able to walk him there before work is incredibly convenient. I also really appreciate the cameras, since I can check on him during the day and see him playing or relaxing. The staff is always warm and welcoming, and it’s clear they know the dogs well. He’s made friends, stays active, and usually comes home pleasantly tired.

The daily report cards are also wonderful! They’re thoughtful, fun to read, and always include sweet photos.

We’ve used their grooming services too and had a great experience with that.

All the employees at Jackson’s Place are so kind and caring! I took my teenager poodle Benjamin to daycare for a 10 day package. What I really love about this place is that they are very strict with which dogs they approve for their groups, they use positive reinforcement training, they are cage free, and they have cameras. My dog always came back nice and tired at the end of the day, and got more confident each time he came in. The only reasons I decided to stop coming were because of the distance from my job, the price (well worth it but unfortunately not in my budget), and the size of the yards (being in the middle of the city, it’s understandable). Bennie’s confidence with men grew a ton because of all the male employees who were slow and gentle with him. Thank you for caring for my baby! I will continue to recommend this place for others who could benefit from their services.

I started taking my dog to Jackson's in 2017. I loved that it was completely off-leash, and how staff sleep overnight with dogs when you board them. I also appreciated how truly caring everyone is. I never worried when I left Murphy there. At one point, I did switch to another daycare because it was cheaper and more convenient for my commute. I never felt as comfortable there, and after a few months, Murphy was diagnosed with terminal cancer. I decided to switch back to Jackson's because I could tell he had been happier there, and I knew how much everyone loved him. This was in January of 2022. He managed to go on for another three years, and it was a great comfort knowing he was being taken care of by people who loved him. I finally had to say goodbye to Murphy this past week, and though it was hard, I know he had a good life, and a big part of that was all the love and care he received from Jackson's. I can never thank them enough for being a part of his journey.
Jackson’s Place is wonderful! Our 4 dogs received the best care by the team at Jackson’s Place during our 11 day trip! Highly recommend and thank you warmly to Jackson’s Place ♥️!

My two Labrador Retrievers love going to Jackson's place.  They have attended daycare since they were 11 weeks old and this place is by far our favorite.  They run in everyday and cant wait to see their teachers and furiends.  Its clean and the staff is friendly, loving, and will treat your four legged children like their own!
We’ve always had a positive experience at Jackson’s Place. Willie grooms our toy poodle. She goes in looking like a tramp and always comes out a lady! Thank you, Willie!

I love Jackson’s Place!!! I won’t take Snoopy anywhere else for grooming. I take Snoopy here for grooming and each time he comes out, he smells like an angel and is super soft. They take great care of him and the groomer here always makes him feel at ease and is so sweet! He also gets a cute bandana at the end!

I’m really disappointed with my experience at this groomer. Their time management is consistently unprofessional, and instead of taking responsibility, they often put the burden of their poor scheduling on the customer. It’s clear they don’t value anyone’s time but their own.

What’s even more frustrating is that despite charging high prices, they make excuses for their lack of organization and care. The owner is particularly rude and defensive when issues are brought up, rather than taking accountability or trying to improve their business practices. It doesn’t feel like they’re interested in doing better—just in dismissing customers.

In addition, they don’t keep proper notes on your dog’s grooming needs. My dog has received multiple bad haircuts because they don’t remember or follow instructions, even after I’ve clearly explained what I wanted. This is unacceptable and shows a lack of attention and professionalism.

It also feels like they treat dogs as quick jobs to rush through rather than beloved pets who deserve patience and proper care.

Unfortunately, this experience doesn’t appear to be unique. Many other reviews mention the same issues—poor service, lack of care, and rude or defensive responses from the owner.

Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this groomer. If you’re paying premium prices, you expect professionalism, reliability, and genuine care for your pet. There are better, more compassionate options out there.
Loved our experience with grooming our Goldendoodle, Archie, at Jackson's Place. Ksenia did fantastic and was so sweet. Archie gets lots of compliments on his new haircut!

I’ve been bringing my dog, Archie, to Willie at Jackson’s Place for grooming since 2019, and I couldn’t be happier with the care and service we receive. Before finding Jackson’s Place, I tried several groomers over the course of a year, but none came close to the level of attention, skill, and kindness we’ve experienced here.

Willie does an exceptional job—Archie always looks fantastic, and I have complete peace of mind knowing he’s safe, well cared for, and genuinely happy. The entire team is incredibly friendly and welcoming, and the owner is absolutely lovely. She’s often at the front desk when I drop Archie off, which speaks volumes about how personally invested she is in the business.

I truly wouldn’t trust anyone else with Archie’s grooming. Jackson’s Place is the best!
My favorite groomers! They always do the perfect cut on my little bud, Hendricks! Highly recommend Jackson’s place (:
